name: Aaron D.
text: Marley is a true professional and excellent at what he does. He has an amazing passion for boating, years of experience and is heavily connected in the marine industry. He takes the utmost care when listing boats, writes the most compelling copy, and has a magnificent attention to detail. Highly knowledgeable and highly recommended!

name: Stephanie K.
text: I recently sold my boat through Flagship International Yacht Brokers, and the experience was nothing short of exceptional. From start to finish, Blayne was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly helpful. His expertise in the market, attention to detail, and clear communication made the entire process smooth and stress-free.

name: Jayden M.
text: I recently purchased a Sunseeker 65 yacht, and I must say the entire experience exceeded my expectations. I am extremely satisfied, not only with the yacht itself but also with the outstanding service provided by Blayne throughout the process. From the very beginning to the final delivery, everything was handled smoothly and professionally.

name: Shelly B.
text: Purchased our dream boat through Marley & his team. Very knowledgable, Adam Brown project managed our transport from Sydney to Perth. Unbelievable!! Everything went smoothly, communication was on point cannot thank Adam enough.

name: Luke G.
text: Peter, Marley and the team at Flagship did an amazing job to sell our boat in a tight market, they worked tirelessly to get the job done, working day and night till a deal was reached, I can't recommend this team highly enough!!

name: David H.
text: Flagship International was exceptional!! Professional, knowledgeable, informative and efficient. They made the entire process smooth and stress-free, achieving a great result in a short time. Highly recommended.

name: Mal M.
text: We purchased a cruiser through Marley and Blayne six months ago. With second hand boats it can often be tricky but our faith in the integrity of these two gentlemen was justified and now we are very happy boat owners.

name: Stuart H.
text: Great service from Marley and the team. Very professional process to find a buyer, run the process, deal with maintenance matters and complete the sale in a short period of time. I would recommend anyone who is serious about buying or selling a boat to contact Marley.

name: Alexandra H.
text: After dealing with some unprofessional and incapable brokers it was so refreshing to meet and deal with Marley. Nothing was a problem, no question stupid. He went out of his way to make things happen and his communication skills are exceptional. HIGHLY RECOMMEND if you are buying or selling!!
